verses.english: “Mendicants, there are ten qualities of an adept.

verses.pali: Asekhā sammādiṭṭhi, asekho sammāsaṅkappo, asekhā sammāvācā, asekho sammākammanto, asekho sammāājīvo, asekho sammāvāyāmo, asekhā sammāsati, asekho sammāsamādhi, asekhaṁ sammāñāṇaṁ, asekhā sammāvimutti—
verses.english: An adept’s right view, right purpose, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, right immersion, right knowledge, and right freedom.

verses.pali: ime kho, bhikkhave, dasa asekhiyā dhammā”ti.
verses.english: These are the ten qualities of an adept.”
